risk_score.rationale: The alert shows suspicious hidden PowerShell and a likely malicious splunkd.exe running from Public with IOC-backed hashes and internal HTTP C2-like traffic to 192.168.10.202:8888, making adversary initiation, repeat occurrence, and harmful impact highly likely.

incident_details.title: High Risk Alerts: NetWitness Endpoint for KELLYWANG
incident_details.description: The alert shows suspicious endpoint activity on an internal host involving a process named splunkd.exe running from Public, along with hidden PowerShell execution and HTTP communication to 192.168.10.202:8888. The behavior and associated hashes suggest a likely malicious or unauthorized internal execution event, but there is no clear evidence of active lateral movement or destructive impact yet.
